prince-george.title: Dawson Creek residents say municipal animal control services a ballot box issue
prince-george.description: In May, city council voted to end its contract with the SPCA, saying it would save taxpayers roughly $300,000. The contact expires on Dec. 1 and will not be replaced.

prince-george.title: Northern B.C. officials demand province honour commitment to build helipad in Prince George
prince-george.description: Elected officials in northern B.C. say they want to see a helipad included in the official business plan for a new acute care tower in Prince George before construction starts in 2027.

prince-george.title: B.C. expediting forestry reviews in Fort St. John, Fort Nelson after 'catastrophic' wildfire losses
prince-george.description: The B.C. government is expediting reviews of timber harvests in Fort St. John and Fort Nelson after years of “catastrophic wildfires” and new Indigenous land designations and wildlife protections.

southeast.title: Great Dane stretchered off mountain near Revelstoke, B.C., in unusual rescue
southeast.description: Rescuers say the owners were exhausted from trying to get the 10-year-old dog off the mountain, and were not prepared for overnight stays in alpine terrain.
